description: This file defines the OAuthClientUsersService class, which manages OAuth client user operations such as creation, retrieval, and updating within a NestJS application. It interacts with repositories, external services, and handles user management logic.

classes.name: OAuthClientUsersService
classes.description: Service class for managing OAuth client users, including creation, retrieval, and updates, with dependencies on repositories and external services.

methods.name: createOAuthClientUser
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client user, assigns tokens, default event types, schedules, and calendars.

methods.name: getExistingUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves an existing user by email associated with an OAuth client.

methods.name: getManagedUsers
methods.description: Fetches managed users associated with a specific OAuth client, with optional filtering.

methods.name: updateOAuthClientUser
methods.description: Updates user details and username based on OAuth client ID and user ID.

methods.name: getOAuthUserEmail
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the OAuth-specific email format for a user.
